body:
Extends the verification-game / audit-dynamics line from one verifier to m.

- Closed-form symmetric equilibrium (detection pinned at s/(s+S); split vs bounty rewards); cheating rises with m under split rewards; redundancy bounded by ln(1/(1-q))/q.
- Linearisation shows the symmetric equilibrium is a saddle for m ≥ 2 (volunteer's dilemma); Hedge concentrates audit burden while keeping detection.
- Bandit (importance-weighted) learners are absorbed at "no cheating, no auditing" without an exploration floor.
- Stdlib-only, 10 tests, white paper with limitations. Portfolio page and README updated.
